source.license: unverified; the v0.52 release metadata does not declare licence terms

representation.scaling: divide each absolute property difference by the training population standard deviation; use 1 when that deviation is 0
representation.choice: laboratory diagnostic choice, not a chemical or applicability-domain definition

distance: mean of the five scaled absolute property differences to the nearest training molecule

split.assignment_rule: descending scaffold-group size; sorted equal-size keys shuffled with the seed; assign whole groups to train until the target is reached, then to test

baseline.target_column: fourth semicolon-delimited field, experimental hydration free energy in kcal/mol
baseline.role: cheapest fitted model already taught by the curriculum, not best model for the data

error_halves: sort test molecules by nearest-training distance, then source ID; lower floor(n/2) versus remaining upper half
excluded_by_design: A claim that this chosen distance is the applicability domain
A performance estimate or inside-domain decision for a new molecule
Tuning the representation, distance, split or baseline to improve a number
A chemical-mechanism claim from a computed-property distance
